== Biography ==
Alexander Glasgow was born around 1806 in Kilmarknock, Ayrshire. He was the son of John Glasgow, a Printer Compositor, and Janet Glasgow. In the 1851 Scottish Census, he was recorded as 45 years old and born about 1806. He was listed as the son of John and Janet Glasgow. Alexander's birthplace was Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, and he resided at Mitchells Land in the civil parish of Kilmarnock. His occupation was stated as a Printer Compositor. This information was gathered during the census conducted in Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, his household included John (21), Isabella (20), Alexander (45), Janet (11), and Margt (10). <ref>https://search.ancestry.co.uk/cgi-bin/sse.dll?indiv=1&dbid=1076&h=1657336&tid=&pid=&queryId=b294571d6e13e57163a81d03f3be2076&usePUB=true&_phsrc=dfz47&_phstart=successSource</ref>

Another record of Alexander Glasgow, this time aged 24 and born in 1805, provides additional details about him. He worked as a weaver and lived on High Street, Glasgow, Lanarkshire. However, he was involved in a criminal case related to theft. The crime occurred in Gallowgate, Glasgow. The trial papers for this case were recorded under the reference JC26/1829/240, in the High Court of the Justiciary Precognitions 1808-1917 documents. These records are archived at the National Records of Scotland, with the reference AD14/29/270. His information can also be found in the Scotland, Court & Criminal Database, under the category of Institutions & organizations, and the subcategory of Courts & Legal. This collection falls under the broader context of Great Britain, Scotland.<ref>https://www.scottishindexes.com/adentry.aspx?adid=829270</ref>

An Alexander Glasgow (born 1811) was found living in Maryland in 1860.
